name: Great Depression
hook: Crash, Dust Bowl and New Deal: the economic disaster that defined the 1930s.

facts.label: the 1929 stock market crash
facts.statement: The Great Depression is usually dated to the October 1929 stock market crash, though it began in Latin America in 1928.

facts.label: Herbert Hoover
facts.statement: Herbert Hoover was president when it began in 1929 and was widely blamed for the Depression.

facts.label: the New Deal
facts.statement: Franklin D. Roosevelt's New Deal was his domestic program to pull the U.S. out of the Depression.

facts.label: 24.9% unemployment
facts.statement: Unemployment reached an all-time U.S. high of 24.9% during the Great Depression.

facts.label: the Dust Bowl
facts.statement: The Dust Bowl devastated the southern plains; Steinbeck's The Grapes of Wrath follows the Joad family.

facts.label: Hard Times
facts.statement: Studs Terkel's Hard Times is an oral history of the Great Depression.

facts.label: Water for Elephants
facts.statement: Sara Gruen's Water for Elephants is set in a circus during the Great Depression.
